name: Ferienwohnung Häringer Mühle
beschreibung:
Wonderfully located in Bad Haering, Ferienwohnung Haeringer Muehle unites the distinctive charm of a historic watermill with modern living comforts. The generously appointed lodging affords ample space and privacy for nature enthusiasts.

The village's famous Kneipp health facilities and scenic trails through the Inn Valley are right at your door.
kurzbeschreibung: Ferienwohnung Haeringer Muehle in Bad Haering provides historic mill charm and peaceful relaxation in Kufsteinerland.
